notes.title: House of Rules Official Full Release! - Dec 19
notes.notes:
House of Rules is finally officially released on Steam! :)

We have made a lot of improvements lately thanks to your feedback.
The version currently uploaded is 2.0.2.

CAUTION!!! Please delete all the files from the earlier versions before downloading and starting v2.x.x.
The saves from the versions 0.x.x and 1.x.x don't load in v2.0.0. and will cause achievement errors and event bugs.

*What's different from the Early Access version:
-Improved the overall stability
-Enabled taking screenshots by pressing F12
-Proofread and edited the dialogues to be more natural
-Brightened the lights
-Shortened the dialogues when seen once
-Redrew the marble puzzle to be more understandable
-Enabled skip for the story scroll in the salon
-Enabled skip for the cutscene before Ending 10(if the ending is already collected)
-Enabled skip for the cutscenes at the end of the game after watching it for the first time
-Added 40 Steam Achievements, 20 in-game achievements available for users without Steam app
-Added a hidden item unlocked when all the endings are collected
-Added post-credits scene when the 20th ending is collected

*What's different from the versions 2.0.1:
-Fixed the save scene error
-Fixed the skip error in the newspaper scene
-Made it easier to achieve the achievement 'Traces of the Past'

(The demo is deactivated as the full version is released.)

We will be keeping our eyes on Steam Community Hub and our e-mail account to fix bugs and errors as soon as possible when reported. So if you have any trouble playing the game, let us know!
Developer E-mail: chiithecat815@gmail.com

Thank you for playing our game! :D

notes.title: Changes to Parody and Streaming Guide
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

There have been some changes to the parody and streaming guide.
We decided to allow uploading any endings of the full version including endings 19 and 20.


New Parody and Streaming Guide:

1. House of Rules strictly bans game unpacking and game modification.

2. Fan art, cartoons, and parodies are allowed as long as the source is indicated, non-commercial, and does not damage the original.

3. Full version(v2.x.x): No limits for making and uploading videos or streaming, even containing the endings 19 and 20.

4. Early Access version(v1.x.x): No limits to live streaming, but please mention that it is the early access version and the full version has more features added when making and uploading videos containing endings 19 and 20.
*Features added in the full version
-40 achievements
-the post-credits scene after the ending 20
-the item that gets unlocked when all endings are collected

5. Please mention our Steam page and the version number when uploading a video of our game.


In other cases, please send a mail to the developer.
Thanks again for playing our game!

notes.title: Update error found - Backup your saves
notes.notes:
It was reported that the game doesn't start when updated.
We've found the reason and discovered several ways to solve this matter:


1. Please backup your saves in Programfiles/Steam/steamapps/common/House of Rules/www/save. After updating the game, paste the files you backed up into the same folder.

2. DO NOT change languages while playing. The language change can cause errors and the game may not start or load saves.

3. If Steam keeps showing error messages when starting the game,
3-(1) Restart Steam client and your computer.
3-(2) Try starting the game by starting the exe file named HouseOfRules in Programfiles/Steam/steamapps/common/House of Rules.
3-(3) Press Ctrl, Alt, and Delete at the same time to open the task manager. Close all the running programs named nw.js. Then try starting the game.

4. If the download keeps pausing, go to the left corner of the Steam client and Press Steam-Settings-Downloads. Change Download Region to Russia-Moscow or US-New York and try again. You can also press 'CLEAR DOWNLOAD CACHE' at the bottom to clear the cache. This requires you to restart the Steam client.


We are grateful for those who have an interest in our game. Tell us if there is any error, and we will do our best to fix it. Thank you so much. :)

notes.title: Early Access version accidentally uploaded as released
notes.notes:
I'm very sorry to deliver this news.
Today, our Early Access version was planned to be released. Due to a lack of understanding of the release process and Steamworks website, I accidentally released the Early Access version as the full version.

To be clear, THE UPLOADED GAME IS THE EARLY ACCESS VERSION, NOT THE FULL VERSION.
We are planning to fix bugs, get feedback, and add more features(post-credits scene, Steam achievements, and so on) in September and release the full version at the end of 2021.

If I am lucky, I will be able to undo the release process and go back to the state of Early Access.
If I am not, there won't be any changes to our plans, but the game will have a big update at the end of 2021 to add more features. The price of the game will increase at that moment.

I'm again sorry to make such a mistake. You can contact us by email(chiithecat815@gmail.com) anytime with any matter.
Thank you for your support.

-Team Chii the Cat
